title: The Second Cup · runtime geometry derivative

source.kind: Editable original Blender still life; distinct from its generated concept and final render.

derivative.geometry_policy: Retain every evaluated source triangle for five hero props and the tabletop; remove background wall/apron and all cameras/lights. No decimation or lossy geometry compression.
derivative.materials: Six uniform opaque core metallic/roughness PBR materials. Procedural microtexture, anisotropy, coating layers, liquid transmission and volume absorption are not reproduced.
derivative.liquid: Actual closed volume and meniscus geometry retained; opaque amber surface approximation, not refractive tea.

generated_reference_policy: The original generated reference and its C2PA remain untouched in the original artwork. No reference image or pixels are included in this GLB.

validation.runtime_boundary: The numerical proof ends at the GLB bytes. Godot import, lighting and native-viewer rendering are separately verified by the viewer workflow.

public_metadata: No absolute producer paths, personal biography, credentials or machine-specific cache paths are stored in this sub-bundle.
